Game Overview

In Rats Erase, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your inner mercenary as Rhino Rock in Rats Erase, battling waves of relentless rodents in a vibrant urban setting. With dynamic movement, strategic grenade use, and powerful weaponry, exterminate intruding rats, score big, and upgrade your arsenal in this fast-paced arcade action extravaganza.
